business_problem: replace operational-database reporting with a scalable data ecosystem that could ingest device telemetry, support self-service reporting, and help utilities manage virtual power plants in near real time.
solution_summary: EnergyHub uses Snowflake on Snowflake to replace operational-database reporting with a scalable data ecosystem that could ingest device telemetry, support self-service reporting, and help utilities manage virtual power plants in near real time. Device telemetry, demand-response, and forecasting data are centralized in Snowflake so utility program and operations teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. The platform also connects with Snowpipe so upstream systems and downstream consumers stay aligned around the same governed data assets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. EnergyHub achieved 1.2M enrolled devices sending data to Snowflake and 55% faster time to insight for utility clients.
